title: ISO 230-3:2020 — Test code for machine tools — Part 3: Determination of thermal effects
locator: Official catalogue abstract: ETVE, rotating spindle, moving linear-axis and rotary-motion thermal distortion tests; confirmed in 2026
notes: Provides test methods for specified machine-tool thermal effects, including thermal distortion caused by rotary motion of components. It does not provide universal allowable drift or warm-up time values. Full text is not archived.
